cs.t: I use a computer at work. I don’t use one at home. I’ve been using an Air 2 since it launched in 2014. Added an Anker keyboard a few years ago and really like typing on it instead of the on-screen keyboard. Made doing crosswords and other stuff a lot easier. Decided it was time to upgrade and figured I’d get the “best” and try to get another 6 years out of it.
